target: DS-V4.1 HBM accelerator, routed-expert fetch at position 1,048,575 (one stack, 32 PCs, 6 experts = 301,056 B a stack a task)
minimum_component: one HBM3E stack (32 PCs, refresh live, REFpb strict), Verilator; die = 4 identical stacks composed analytically

exact.scope: every case of every variant: every released line compared, 0 DRAM violations

selected: sel90 = ORDER=1 (rate-balanced w13-first line order, load-time cfg_lut) + PCPROT=1 (per-PC refresh protection) + STEER=1 (in-stream REFpb slot steering) + NWIN=300 (ramp-aware notice); all default-off, LAW=6 unchanged

optional_deeper_landing.variant: sel90_law7 (128-deep landing, +32x64x259 b = 0.53 Mbit a stack)
optional_deeper_landing.note: stream only; first access identical to sel90, so no token gain: not selected

limiters.fixed_per_pc: ~15 of 309 cycles a PC: 4-bank ACT ramp of the first expert (tRRD_S at the CK/2 row slot, 12 cycles) + BG tCCD_L at expert switches; caps a perfectly-aligned stack at ~0.95
limiters.landing: R5a line order sends 8 lines a row to 4 SMs in the w13 tail and w2 phase (8 sectors/hclk vs LAND 4 a 833-ps cycle = 4.9/hclk): ORDER=1 removes it (+2.6 pt)
limiters.refresh: REFpb at the window start (tRREFD on the first ACTs) and on the lookahead ACT group; a REFpb on a set already finished but still in `prot` landed on a still-needed set (tRFCpb 196 cycles): PCPROT/STEER/NWIN
limiters.residual_tail: min 0.81 = 4 of 6 experts in one bank set (unavoidable same-set adjacency, tRTP+tRP+tRCD ~41 cycles each); same-set adversarial 0.53 (was 0.48)

per_token.note: token composition (audit rule): 40 fetches x first access (w13 at every SM); the rest of each burst streams faster than the SMs consume it, so the stream fraction does not enter the token

verdict: >=90% REACHED on the mean (91.3%, was 86.0%; min 80.8%, was 61.4%) with zero-byte-change, default-off logic; per-user gain 0.10% mean / 0.17% worst (< 1%): NOT a per-user lever (owner rule REJECT as a speed lever); adopt only as compliance with the >=90% HBM-load rule at the parent/owner decision. The measured fetch is now BELOW the model (4.974 us vs 5.33 us).
